normative_extracts.quote: Reading geometric properties after invalidating styles forces the browser to run layout synchronously.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: NeedsLayout flag triggers synchronous UpdateStyleAndLayoutTree on every interleaved geometric read.

production_failures.symptom: Long Task > 150ms when rendering a list of cards
production_failures.root_cause: Loop reading offsetHeight and immediately mutating style.height across 80 cards.
production_failures.mitigation: Read all heights into an array first, then apply all style writes together.

production_failures.symptom: Scroll jank with JS-computed sticky headers
production_failures.root_cause: Reading scrollY and getBoundingClientRect() inside an unthrottled scroll listener.
production_failures.mitigation: Use CSS position: sticky or IntersectionObserver.
